create_token_tensorizer: create a TokenTensorizer to convert text into padded token tensors with a vocabulary
create_label_tensorizer: create a LabelTensorizer to numberize string labels into index tensors for classification
create_float_list_tensorizer: create a FloatListTensorizer to tensorize dense float features with optional normalization
create_seq_token_tensorizer: create a SeqTokenTensorizer to tensorize a sequence of sentences for dialogue tasks
run_initialize_tensorizers: run initialize_tensorizers to build vocabularies by streaming a data source through tensorizers
